name: poly_inset_dirty_parity
description: Polygon inset, positive and negative, on oblique folds, plates with holes and notches, counter-wound faces and a scale step. This family diverges on three quarters of the dirty bases, so these are the cells where the two engines DO meet -- and a regression that moved the meeting point would show here first.

provenance.notes: Frozen precisely because the family is fragile: a fixture is worth most where the surrounding behaviour is known to be delicate, and the surviving agreements are a thin ledge. CHANNELS: the sweep's comparison was never vertex-only -- it compared the vertex multiset, the edge multiset, faces BOTH as ordered rings (winding shows) and as unordered position sets, the material partition, the per-face 'did this face's own tag change', and the post-command selection. Re-checked independently over all 215 frozen cases: ZERO agree on vertices while differing on ordered face rings, so nothing frozen here is a vertex-channel-only agreement. PRECISION: the sweep compared at 1e-4 and this fixture's tolerance matches it. The actual reproduction is far tighter -- 208 of the 215 cases are bit-identical at the dumps' 6 decimals and the remaining 7 agree to 3e-6 or better, that being the worst deviation anywhere in the set. The tolerance is the MEASUREMENT's bound, not the data's.
